details: The latest US jobs report for June showed only 57,000 new jobs added, falling significantly short of expectations. This weak labor market data has reduced market anticipation for imminent Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, fueling speculation of a more dovish monetary policy stance later in the year. In response, risk assets, including Bitcoin, have seen a notable rebound, with BTC climbing above $62,000. Investors are now keenly awaiting July's Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for further indications on the Fed's future actions.
title: US Jobs Report Eases Rate Hike Fears, Boosts Crypto

details: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde recently defended the central bank's decision in June to raise its deposit rate by 25 basis points to 2.25%. Lagarde cited persistent inflation, largely stemming from Middle East energy shocks, as the reason for the move. While higher euro rates generally signal tighter global liquidity, potentially pressuring crypto valuations, there are also signs of easing inflation in some Eurozone regions, which could eventually lead to discussions about future rate cuts.
title: ECB Defends Rate Hike Amid Persistent Inflation

details: With the Federal Reserve's monetary policy heavily data-dependent, market participants are closely monitoring the upcoming US Consumer Price Index (CPI) release for July. This inflation report is widely considered a "pivot point" for financial markets and could significantly influence the Federal Reserve's stance on interest rates for the latter half of 2026. A cooling inflation print could reinforce expectations for rate cuts, providing further support for risk assets like cryptocurrencies, while a hotter reading might reignite tightening fears.
title: Anticipation Builds for Critical July US CPI Data
